_meta.corpus: 17 approved HSIYC (HITSZ International Youth Club / 哈工大（深圳）国际青年俱乐部) WeChat article PDFs rendered to 188 page images

scale.note: CSS px = measured px * 0.96. Validated: body glyph band 16 px -> 15.4 CSS px (WeChat default 15 px); line pitch 24 px -> 23 CSS px (line-height 1.6).

_meta.method: Pillow 12.3.0 + numpy 2.3.5. Colours are modal RGB of measured pixel sets (middle row of a rule; darkest-12% modal for glyph cores). Geometry is detected pixel runs. Scripts: _work/analysis/sample_pages/_scripts/{lines,probe,rowprofile,cardinfo,bands,bandsum,gutters,photogrid,rank,inventory}.py
caveats: 57 of 188 pages (30.3%) are pure white filler pages; articles 08_ (26/29), 09_ (14/18), 10_ (8/12) are largely unusable as visual references.
24 pages still contain a failed-image placeholder frame (rose #83395E).
Articles 14_, 16_, 17_ render body text at #AAAAAA-#B2B2B2 (captured mid fade-in animation). Do NOT adopt those as body colours.
No multi-photo grid with white gutters exists: gutters.py found only 28 candidate gutters in 188 pages, all 60-94 px long and inside poster artwork.

typography._units: size_px values are CSS px estimates = measured glyph band px * 0.96; band_px is the raw measurement. font values are INFERRED from raster stroke shapes, not from embedded font data.

h1.font: system CJK sans (PingFang SC / Source Han Sans SC class) - inferred

section_numbered_header_label.note: band covers the 2-line label block, not one line

body_cn.font: system CJK sans (PingFang SC / Source Han Sans SC class) - inferred

photo_grid.finding: No multi-photo row with white gutters exists in the corpus. gutters.py (paper-white gutter 2-40 px wide, >=60 px long, flanked by ink on both sides) returned 9 vertical + 19 horizontal hits across 188 pages, every one 60-94 px long and inside poster artwork. Photo layout in the approved corpus is one full-bleed image per block.

blocks.name: wechat_header
blocks.structure: H1 title line then byline line

blocks.name: cover_art

blocks.notes: Must be supplied as an image asset; carries the watermark 公众号·哈工大深圳校区国际教育中心 bottom-right. Appears once at the top, never repeated per page.

blocks.name: lead_paragraph
blocks.structure: CN paragraph block followed by an EN paragraph block
blocks.notes: 15 px / line-height 1.6 / line pitch 24 px / paragraph gap 32 px / no indent / left aligned at x=134

blocks.name: card
blocks.structure: 1 px navy border, square corners, no fill; optional CAPS eyebrow, CN body in navy, EN body in grey, optional 4 px inner rule and footer
blocks.notes: w=584-585 px; interior #FFFFFF at 66-74%; padding ~8 px vertical

blocks.name: numbered_section_header
blocks.structure: '01' numeral + CN label + italic EN label, then 4-6 px navy rule + 2 px navy rule, then italic sub-label
blocks.notes: group width 280 px, centred on x=427; EN label is the SECOND line (CN above EN); ALL CAPS used only for eyebrow labels, never the heading

blocks.name: numbered_row_header
blocks.structure: 'NN' light numeral + 1 px hairline rule 291 px + right-aligned 'Day N · Country'
blocks.notes: numeral x0=146; rule x=138-428; right label ends x=719; followed by a centred 3-line bilingual stack in #1B3049

blocks.name: bilingual_section_heading
blocks.structure: two-line CN + one-line EN (centred, CN above EN) OR one-line EN + one-line CN (left aligned, EN above CN)
blocks.notes: CN-above-EN in 8/17 articles (01,02,03,04,05,11,13,16); EN-above-CN only in article 15. Do not mix within one article.

blocks.name: full_bleed_photo
blocks.notes: 624 px wide (x=112-735), 22 px wider on each side than the text measure; aspect example 1.46; no border, radius or caption

blocks.name: photo_carousel_strip
blocks.structure: rounded 1 px outline frame with the hint 'slide right for more pictures' centred on the bottom edge, border interrupted behind the hint
blocks.notes: 565x365 px, radius 8-11 px, 0 tiles rendered in the corpus

blocks.name: numbered_list
blocks.structure: '01 <中文> | <English>' rows with a small chevron flush right and a light grey hairline between rows
blocks.notes: row band 15-16 px, row pitch 56 px, x=136-665

blocks.name: rounded_card_stack
blocks.structure: stacked 1 px light border cards, radius ~8 px, gap 21 px; each card holds '第N讲 | Lecture N' + CN line + EN line
blocks.notes: x=148-704 (557 px), h=84-91 px per card; AcademiaSphere/学域 series only

blocks.name: double_border_card
blocks.structure: 6 px red rule + 5 px blue rule bounding a white card with a navy tab header

blocks.name: pill_badge
blocks.structure: fully rounded outline pill holding '时间 Time' / '地点 Location' / '活动 ACTIVITIES'

blocks.name: signoff_block
blocks.structure: rule above, 3 centred lines (CN club name / EN club name / brand), rule below
blocks.notes: rules span 624 px; line pitch 24 px; variants: single 1 px rules (01_), double rules (15_), near-black text (03_), 'AcademiaSphere x Nexus Hive' vs 'AcademiaSphere' third line

blocks.name: credits_block
blocks.structure: 6 rows flush left: 文字 | 图片 | 排版 | 一审 | 二审 | 三审
blocks.notes: x=136, pitch 25 px, band 11-16 px; four different label vocabularies exist across the corpus (see VISUAL_PATTERNS.md D.2)

blocks.name: toc_card

blocks.notes: eyebrow band 12 px x=137; heads band 9 px; links band 18 px; left col left-aligned, right col right-aligned ending x=719; optional '修改于<date>' trailer
